newsitem.title: CROATIA: President Tudjman returns home after treatment.
newsitem.headline: President Tudjman returns home after treatment.

text.p: Croatia's ailing President Franjo Tudjman returned home on Saturday to resume his duties after medical treatment in Washington.
Looking visibly pale and thinner, with hollow cheeks, Tudjman stepped off the plane at Zagreb airport to be met by senior officials.
U.S. sources said the 74-year-old president was being treated for stomach cancer while state media in Croatia said he was suffering from "digestive problems".
Shortly after landing, Tudjman is expected to speak briefly to journalists for the first time in weeks.
He will later receive U.S. General Jacques Klein, head of the last Serb-held enclave in Croatia, administered by the United Nations.
